name: retract_fact
description: Retract the current fact for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): appends a hash-chained op='retract' event (history preserved, never deleted) and sets the resolution status to 'retracted'. The retracting source's authority + policy_version are recorded. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.

source.description: The source performing the retraction (ranked by authority policy for this predicate).

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the retraction.

assessor_type.description: Optional kind of actor performing the retraction.
